#pragma once

#include <string>

// Sits above nothing: a blank line follows.

namespace kapi {

/// Parses recipes.
class Parser {
public:
    /// Makes a parser.
    explicit Parser(std::string source);

    /**
     * Runs the parser.
     * @return the number of blocks
     */
    [[nodiscard]] int run() const;

    /// Stops the parser.
    void stop() { stopped_ = true; }

private:
    bool stopped_ = false; ///< Whether the parser has stopped.
    // A plain comment on a field.
    std::string source_;
};

/// The kinds of block.
enum class Kind {
    /// Plain text.
    Text,
    Code,
};

/// The largest of two values.
template <typename T>
T largest(T a, T b);

/// A path of names.
using Path = std::string;

}  // namespace kapi

/// Runs the parser out of line.
int kapi::Parser::run() const {
    // Inside the function.
    return 0;
}
